audit.why: Senna's early soul-scaling poke and late infinite scaling with Dawning Shadow are her two real spikes; Renata's window is levels 4-6 into first item once Bailout lets her force fights.

edits.before: E-poke the pair — the missiles shield yours and bill theirs in one cast.
edits.after: Piercing Darkness out-ranges and self-heals through your poke from level 1.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the root-throw relocates whoever steps wrong.
edits.after: Last Embrace's delayed root sets up picks as her soul lead widens.

edits.before: Full kit: W on the carry turns even trades into insured ones — the bailout math is rude.
edits.after: Her poke and growing soul lead keep outpacing you — stand apart to deny the root chain.

edits.before: Late Renata flips fights: berserk the clump, bail the carry, and watch their formation eat itself.
edits.after: Infinite soul scaling and Dawning Shadows global shield reclaim the late game outside your range.

edits.before: - Senna Last Embrace (Root): matchup-defining — The root spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions and carry. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Bailout banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Senna Last Embrace (W) is 11s and spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions and carry. - Piercing Darkness (Q, 15s) heals her; it is an anti-heal target once you land Grievous Wounds. - Keep W Bailout banked.
